 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. CLEVELAND — Do the Cavaliers respect the Cup?
 The Cavs will face the Indiana Pacers in an NBA Cup game on Friday, Nov. 20, at Rocket Arena . For those of you who respect the Cup, the Cavs and Pacers are both 1-1 in East Group B.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For those of you who are more focused on the bigger picture beyond the Cup, the Cavs (8-8) and Pacers (5-10) are off to disappointing starts this season. Injuries have contributed to the Cavs and Pacers using nine different starting lineups apiece. The Pacers will be without star guard Tyrese Haliburton for the 12th consecutive game after he suffered a hamstring injury against the Milwaukee Bucks on Oct. 26.
 Tipoff for Cavs versus Pacers is scheduled for 7:30 p.m. Updates will be here throughout the game:

 Cavs injury report vs. Pacers. Peyton Watson is available
 The Cavs upgraded starting wing Peyton Watson (low back contusion) from questionable to available. Watson sat out one game after taking a nasty fall on Monday, Nov. 16, against the Chicago Bulls.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Cavs also ruled out the following players:
 forward Zack Austin (NBA G League — two-way contract)
 center Khalifa Diop (NBA G League — on assignment)
 starting forward Evan Mobley (left great toe sprain)
 forward Nae'Qwan Tomin (low back stress reaction)
 wing Jaylon Tyson (right ankle injury management)
 center Earnest Udeh Jr. (NBA G League — two-way contract)

 The Pacers upgraded guard T.J. McConnell (right hamstring strain) from probable to play to available. They upgraded guards Andrew Nembhard (left hip sprain) and Braden Smith (right ankle sprain) from questionable to available.
 The Pacers also ruled out the following players:
 wing Johnny Furphy (right ACL repair/surgery)
 guard Tyrese Haliburton (left hamstring strain)
 guard Ben Sheppard (left meniscus surgery)

(Photo by Jason Miller/Getty Images) Cleveland Cavaliers vs. Indiana Pacers history
 The Cavs have an all-time record of 108-111 against the Pacers in the regular season. The head-to-head playoff record between the two teams is tied 10-10.
 In the most recent Cavs-Pacers postseason series, Cleveland lost 4-1 in the 2025 Eastern Conference semifinals.
 Will Cleveland Cavs and Indiana Pacers play each other again this season?
 The Cavs and Pacers are slated to play three more times during the 2026-27 regular season. Cleveland will host Indiana on Dec. 1. The Cavs will visit the Pacers on Feb. 10 and April 9.
 Cleveland Cavaliers forward Mario Hezonja dunks against the Dallas Mavericks on Nov. 14, 2026, in Cleveland. Where to watch Cavaliers vs Pacers tonight on TV
 Cavs versus Pacers will be televised by DAZN , which will stream all regular-season games not selected exclusively for national broadcasts.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement How can I listen to Cavs vs Pacers tonight on radio?
 The local radio broadcast of the Cavs-Pacers game can be heard via WTAM (1100-AM), WMMS (100.7-FM) or La Mega Cleveland (Spanish broadcast, 1300-AM).
